basic_info.description: Discover this sun-drenched 2BD/2BA + Office corner condo, a haven of luxury and convenience with modern finishes. Situated in a sophisticated, pet-friendly building near Bayview Park, this open floor plan condo offers unbeatable access to highways 101, 280, and MUNI for an effortless commute to downtown SF or the South Bay. The open floor plan features brand new hardwood floors and premium finishes. The kitchen, a culinary delight, includes new countertops and stainless steel appliances, seamlessly flowing into the bright and inviting living and dining areas, perfect for entertaining. Bask in the abundant natural light streaming through large windows and unwind on one of two private balconies with your favorite morning brew or evening cocktail. The primary suite is a luxurious retreat, complete with a spacious walk-in closet and a large en-suite bathroom featuring a shower over tub and a generous vanity with dual sinks. The condo also includes a private office, secured garage parking, and bike storage for your convenience. Step out into the vibrant neighborhood and savor a coffee and pastry from Craftsman & Wolves, a pint from convivial Laughing Monkey Brewing, or dine at one of the area's beloved eateries. This condo is your perfect base for urban adventure and relaxation.
